title: Bounded Unknown-Cut Acyclic Computational DAG Discovery (1-4 Active Nodes, depth <= 4, fan-out <= 2, K = 1 Always Legal)

empirical_break_even_definition.pooled_definition: Smallest K in 1..8 such that pooled cumulative Scope-1 cost delta (Hegel - Baseline) is strictly < 0 for all k in K..8 AND pooled pass-rate difference at K=8 >= -0.05; otherwise 'not_reached' (or 'unknown_partial_usage' if any unknown attempt > 0).

structural_verification_gates.monolithic_k1_non_fragmentation: On monolithic_coupled clusters, Hegel must retain K=1 (keep_monolithic) without degrading quality or incurring runaway split overhead.
structural_verification_gates.multi_stage_unknown_cut_discovery: On K=3 and K=4 cascades, Hegel must autonomously discover K>=3 active nodes without prescribed split boundaries and realize 0-LLM compositional closures on unseen combinations.
structural_verification_gates.shared_prefix_diamond_and_skip_exec_coun: On diamond_k4 and asymmetric_skip_dag_k4, Hegel must verify max_fanout == 2 and runtime exec_count[shared_node] == 1 in isolated Docker.
structural_verification_gates.cut_withdrawal_and_old_domain_preservati: On cross-branch interaction steps, rewire_edge / merge_nodes must issue a 4-link external ProbeReceiptStore FK CutWithdrawalMergeReceipt while preserving the old separable DAG for colliding revisits.
structural_verification_gates.plain_dict_substrate_parity_ablation: Post-run 0-LLM plain-dict routing parity check on frozen Step-06 checkpoints before the final 2 revisits, reported transparently.
